name: Breath as it is

cues.text: Let your breath move on its own. There is nothing to change.
If you like, start counting each out-breath. Let the breath stay as it is.
Keep noticing for a few more breaths.

stop_prompts: Stop if you feel distressed or uneasy.
You can stop at any time.

copy.intent: Notice your breath as it is, without changing it.
copy.end: Let your attention widen to the room. Take your time before you move on.
copy.notice: This is not medical advice. If you have a health condition or feel unwell, speak to a qualified clinician before you practise.

note: Research gives no pacing for natural-breath observation (no control). Pacing is the research default rate (5 s in, 5 s out) as an ambient, unguided visual only. Evidence is weak: no technique-level review found. Verify before release.
